summary: Tired places bent hands on the upper chest and lets them drop and sag, shoulders slumping with them.
movement: Hands rotate downward at the wrist, body sags
steps: Place the fingertips of two bent hands on your upper chest, near the collarbones.
Let the hands rotate downward so the fingertips drag and the palms turn up slightly.
Drop your shoulders and let your face sag. Exhale.
mistakes: Keeping your posture upright. The slump is part of the sign.
